name: Lean-Back Cable Tricep Extension
description: Torso leaned back ~45° facing away from a HIGH cable pulley — either sitting back on an incline bench or kneeling on the floor with the hips sat back. Grip a rope or bar with the elbows bent and the hands near the chest, then extend the arms until they are straight, finishing down by the hips/thighs. Elbows stay put; only the forearms move. The arms NEVER travel behind the head — the path is bent-to-straight, chest-to-hip, and the backward lean is what puts the triceps long head on stretch. Hits the long head with lat involvement from the high cable angle. Also loosely called an "incline cable overhead tricep extension" (the borrowed name from the source video) — but "overhead" misdescribes the path and is what caused years of wrong cues; prefer the descriptive name.

media.caption: Coach Francis incline cable overhead extension demo — HIGH cable, 45° bench, lat + tricep long head
